conventions.FORBIDDEN_WORDS: whole-word, case-insensitive match of a word or phrase in the PDF list
conventions.ALL_CAPS: violated when a full line of two or more words is in capitals
conventions.TAGLINE_REQUIRED: violated when no tagline-like text ('Innovation. Trust') appears
conventions.TAGLINE_POSITION: violated when a tagline is present but is not the last line
conventions.TAGLINE_WORDING: violated when tagline-like text is present but the exact tagline is not
conventions.TONE: human label, scored only where listed expected or not in dont_care
conventions.FINANCIAL_DISCLAIMER: human label, applies to ads promoting a financial product
conventions.dont_care: pair excluded from scoring because reasonable reviewers could disagree or the rule does not apply
